title: Envelope
description:
One response.

Under `--json --schema-version 1`, every rlx command prints exactly one of these.
On rlxd's socket, each response is one of these plus the request's `id`.

```json
{"schema_version": 1, "ok": true, "data": {}}
{"schema_version": 1, "ok": false, "error": {"code": "not_a_tty", "message": "…", "hint": "…", "detail": "…"}}
```

id.description: On the socket, the `id` of the request this answers. Absent from the CLI's output.

schema_version.description: The schema version this document follows.

anyOf.description:
It was refused or failed. The process exits 1, 2 on a usage error, or 70 when
the command is not implemented.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: Why a request was refused or failed.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable code, such as `unauthorized` or `not_a_tty`.

detail.description:
More about what went wrong: an underlying error's text, or an object whose
fields the code defines (`incompatible_protocol` gives `{"supported": [1]}`).

hint.description: What to do about it, for a person.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person.
